title: CorrelationContext
description: Opaque correlation identifiers for a Worker execution. Not database UUID types. Not domain lifecycle state.

correlation_id.description: Opaque id joining logs, traces, and this execution.

experiment_id.description: Opaque Experiment reference. Not Hypothesis outcome.

request_id.description: Opaque id for this authorized request.

parent_request_id.description: Optional opaque id of a parent request.
